about.style: melodic, uplifting broken-beat electronica / 64k-intro soundtrack: lush detuned pads, FM plucks and sidechain-pumping basses; dreamy and euphoric
about.tempo: 130 BPM, syncopated broken-beat groove with sidechain pump
about.engine: WaveSabre: Slaughter, Falcon, Thunder (effects Echo, Chamber, Leveller, Scissor, Crusher, Smasher)
about.description: The intro (bars 1-16) builds from a soft pad, vocal chops, hats and claps. The kick and bass enter at bar 17, and the detuned pad and 16th FM arpeggio join at bar 33. A riser leads into a second half at bar 49 with an added FM growl bass, then the climax (bars 65-96) brings a huge reverb snare. A pad outro runs from bar 97 to bar 118. The tonal centre is B♭ minor / D♭ major, and the mood is bright, airy and nostalgic; the project is named after logicoma's 2016 64k intro Elysian.

about.tempo: one hit per 24-32 bars, on the downbeat
about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: oscillators off, noise only, high-pass filter (~2.3 kHz) with slow mod-envelope sweep, long amp decay/release
about.description: Marks the section starts at bars 17, 41, 65 and 97 with a 4-bar noise crash, widened by a short Echo, Chamber reverb and a dotted tempo echo.

about.tempo: one hit per 8-48 bars, on the downbeat
about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: noise only through a resonant high-pass (~1 kHz) swept by the mod envelope, then Crusher (sample-rate reduction)
about.description: A grittier crash layer at bars 33, 41 and 81, crushed, slightly delayed and put in a dark Chamber reverb.

about.tempo: one long hit per section (bars 49 and 97)
about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: noise through a high-pass whose cutoff is driven almost fully by a slowly decaying mod envelope, full-sustain amp
about.description: A long falling noise sweep (about 7 beats) that opens the second half at bar 49 and the outro at bar 97; the tempo echo send is automated.

about.engine: WaveSabre Thunder: one GSM 6.10-compressed sample (a vocal exclamation, judging by the track name), played one-shot
about.description: A vocal shout dropped at phrase starts from bar 9 to bar 113, washed in Chamber reverb and a quarter-note echo, with automated EQ low/high cuts sweeping its band.

about.engine: WaveSabre Thunder: one GSM 6.10-compressed sample (a short vocal syllable), one-shot, retriggered rhythmically
about.description: A chopped vocal syllable repeated in syncopated 8ths from bar 3 to bar 95, band-limited by a Leveller whose low cut, high cut and Q are automated (filter-sweep effect), plus reverb.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: noise only through a resonant low-pass (~260 Hz) opened by a mod envelope with slow attack, swelling amp attack
about.description: A one-beat noise whoosh that rises into phrase starts across bars 8-94, cleaned up with a low cut and a short Echo.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: noise through a resonant band-pass with a decaying mod envelope on the cutoff, into Chamber reverb
about.description: A downward noise fall patch that has no notes in the arrangement, so it is silent; it was probably left over from an earlier draft.

about.tempo: syncopated broken-beat kick, about two per bar
about.engine: WaveSabre Thunder: one GSM 6.10-compressed kick sample, one-shot; Leveller boosts the low-mid body and the click
about.description: Drives the groove from bar 17 to bar 97 with a syncopated, not four-on-the-floor, pattern that changes at bars 49 and 65; it also keys the sidechain ducking via Kick Chain.

about.engine: WaveSabre Thunder: one GSM 6.10-compressed rimshot sample, one-shot, no effects (small send to the CPU Saver Reverb)
about.description: Off-beat rim clicks fill out the groove from bar 17 to bar 96, with new variants at bars 33 and 65.

about.engine: WaveSabre Thunder: one GSM 6.10-compressed castanet sample (per the track name), one-shot, low-cut by a Leveller
about.description: A light castanet accent that never lands on the beat, playing from bar 17 to bar 96.

about.style: sampled hand clap with short room
about.engine: WaveSabre Thunder: one GSM 6.10-compressed clap sample, one-shot, into a small Chamber room
about.description: The backbeat from bar 1 to bar 97, routed through the [Drums] bus; it also feeds the Clap Chain sidechain key that ducks the music.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: noise only, high-pass at ~11.7 kHz, very short decay, no sustain; Leveller presence boost
about.description: The closed hats of the first half, bars 1-48, with frequent pattern variants; they drop out for the second half.

about.engine: WaveSabre Thunder: one GSM 6.10-compressed hi-hat sample, one-shot, short Chamber room
about.description: Off-beat 16th hats with velocity accents from bar 1 to bar 95, changing pattern at bars 13 and 65.

about.engine: WaveSabre Thunder: one GSM 6.10-compressed hat/crack sample, one-shot, low-cut and short Chamber room
about.description: A sharp off-beat hat accent between bars 1 and 95 that adds snap to the hat groove.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: noise only, high-pass at ~9.1 kHz, short attack/decay; Crusher bit/rate reduction, band-limited by a Leveller
about.description: A lo-fi shaker texture running from bar 4 to bar 96.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: noise only, high-pass at ~9.1 kHz, very short attack and no decay tail
about.description: Clean shaker ticks in the first half (bars 1-48), placed off the 16th grid for a swung, humanised feel.

about.engine: WaveSabre Leveller (EQ) on a group bus
about.description: Groups clap, hats and shakers; its automated low and high cuts filter the whole drum kit for build-ups and breakdowns.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: osc1 mixed waveform plus noise through a band-pass, slow amp attack, automated cutoff; Scissor distortion and Chamber reverb
about.description: A long rising swell in the last bars before bars 49, 65 and 97 (notes at bars 45, 61 and 93), with its band-pass cutoff automated upward.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: noise through a band-pass at ~3.5 kHz, medium decay and release, into a wet Chamber reverb
about.description: A huge, washy backbeat snare that only plays in the climax section, bars 65-96.

about.tempo: off-beat accent, a few per section
about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: mostly noise through a resonant band-pass at ~11.5 kHz, short decay, a little pitch envelope; short Echo and high-shelf boost
about.description: Open-hat accents placed at phrase ends between bars 13 and 48.

about.engine: WaveSabre Thunder: one GSM 6.10-compressed clap sample through Chamber reverb, a short feedback Echo and a Smasher compressor
about.description: A big one-off clap at the ends of phrases (around bars 9, 25 and 49) that sets up the next section.

about.tempo: long sustained root notes, one or two per 2 bars
about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: osc1 saw/pulse morph (narrow pulse) plus a detuned osc2, resonant low-pass ~1 kHz with filter-envelope attack, vibrato, unison detune; Scissor distortion
about.description: Holds the chord roots (D♭, G♭, B♭ and A♭ areas) from bar 17 to bar 95. It is ducked by the kick/clap sidechain, so it pumps, and its transpose is automated.

about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: 2-operator FM with a high modulator ratio, strong operator feedback, fast modulator envelope and 2-voice unison; Leveller low boost, Scissor distortion
about.description: Doubles the bass line from bar 49 to bar 95 with a distorted FM growl. Its high cut is automated and it is sidechain-ducked with the rest of the music.

about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: pure sine operators at a 1:1 ratio with a soft decaying envelope; Crusher sample-rate reduction into a 100%-wet Chamber reverb
about.description: Quiet, randomly placed high sine pings with low velocities (B♭ minor pentatonic area) from bar 13 to bar 112, forming a glittering ambient layer.

about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: 2-operator FM with a ~5:1 ratio, feed-forward and short modulator decay, 2-voice unison detune; Leveller high cut, Chamber and Echo
about.description: A running 16th-note arpeggio in F/A♭ octaves from bar 33 to bar 96, changing figure at bar 65. Its high cut and echo send are automated.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: two pulse-width saw/pulse oscillators detuned against each other, a little noise, unison detune, vibrato; low-pass with automated cutoff
about.description: Carries the B♭-minor/D♭-major chord progression in 2-bar, 5-note chords through the main body, bars 33-95, with a dotted tempo echo and filter-cutoff automation.

about.engine: WaveSabre Slaughter: pulse plus a second oscillator two octaves up, noise, low cutoff (~150 Hz) opened by a slow filter envelope, wide unison spread; Smasher, Chamber, Echo
about.description: Plays the chord progression in the intro (bars 1-32) and the outro (bars 97-113) as a soft, breathing pad. Its release and EQ low cut are automated.

about.tempo: rapid triplet-32nd runs, a few per section
about.engine: WaveSabre Falcon: 2-operator FM with a 1:1 ratio, feedback and feed-forward, slow carrier attack; Chamber reverb and an automated echo send
about.description: Quiet, fast ascending D♭-major arpeggio flourishes spanning several octaves, placed at phrase transitions from bar 17 to bar 97.

about.engine: WaveSabre send-only track (no devices)
about.description: Receives the Kick and feeds it as the sidechain signal into the [FUCK A DUCK] bus compressors.

about.engine: WaveSabre send-only track (no devices)
about.description: Receives the Clap and feeds it as a second sidechain signal into the [FUCK A DUCK] bus compressors.

about.engine: WaveSabre Chamber reverb (100% wet) and a Leveller
about.description: A shared send reverb for the rim, castanet, hats, shakers, OH, bass and pad, used to save CPU. Its EQ high cut is automated.

about.engine: WaveSabre: two Smasher compressors in series, both sidechained
about.description: The music bus (riser, snare, OH, Super Clap, basses, FM layers, pads, Trill and the reverb return) is ducked by the Kick Chain and Clap Chain keys for the pumping groove.
